Devkitty 1.0.0 (build 419)

Work Board

  • A session that waits for you (needs input or blocked) moves its card to Need Human. When it reports working again, the card goes back to In Progress.
  • A card with an open PR goes back to In Progress while its session fixes review comments.
  • Session reports reach the Board after the session moves into a Git worktree, and when a queued message follows the report.
  • No more empty second card (2/2) next to a task card. Old empty cards from build 417 are removed by themselves.
  • The Project filter uses the repository a card's terminal works in.
  • Move to Trash and Close Tabs closes the workspace too when the card owns all its tabs.

Board AI

  • After a restart, idle sessions keep their state instead of showing unknown.
  • Board AI never types into a session whose state is unknown.
